text:
Maya: quick one on the compact card error that shows under small widgets — it gets truncated and users miss retry. want a very short microcopy + a11y checklist. Jared: what about 'Save failed. Retry.' super short and actionable. Evelyn: Love brevity. also need an aria-live announcement so screen readers pick it up. set aria-live="assertive" and test with VoiceOver. Maya: proposing three variants we can A/B in canary: 1) 'Save failed. Retry.' 2) 'Couldn't save. Retry.' 3) 'Save failed. Connection?' Which one fits two tight lines and reads crisply? Tom: 1 feels clean. prefer button label 'Retry' to keep verb short. Jared: UI constraint: smallest breakpoint allows ~30 chars before clipping; 1 and 2 are equal lengthish. We'll cap to two lines and ellipsize rest. Evelyn: accessibility notes to include in the PR: - aria-live example: ```html
Save failed. Retry.
``` - ensure the Retry button receives focus only when user navigates, not auto-focus. - color: current orange token ("warning") fails contrast on small text. suggest #D9534F or #E11D2B for >4.5:1 against white. Maya: about a secondary tiny link for 'Report' or 'Help' — thoughts? worried it'll crowd the compact layout. Tom: skip visible secondary link in compact view. We can surface help in expanded state or under ellipsis. copybot: microcopy suggestion for expanded tooltip: 'If this keeps happening, contact support.' keep that out of compact variant. Jared: impl notes: add a stable data-testid to the error element and inject without animation so SRs get consistent announcements. Add a test asserting the aria-live text equals the visible copy. Evelyn: also verify error icon + text meet contrast and that text size doesn't drop below 12px on mobile. avoid moving focus unexpectedly. Maya: plan: land variant 1 ('Save failed. Retry.') with button 'Retry', update color token to #D9534F, no visible help link in compact. I'll push PR to style-tokens branch and drop link. Tom: let's canary it for a week and monitor support tickets. Maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/2468 — includes copy tokens, aria-live example, contrast token change. copybot: :white_check_mark: automated checks queued. Maya: thanks everyone, will follow up with analytics for click-throughs on Retry.
